scripts.prisma:sqlite:migrate: cross-env PRISMA_PROVIDER=sqlite DATABASE_URL='file:./prisma/dev.db' npx prisma migrate dev --name init --migrations-dir=prisma/migrations_sqlite
scripts.prisma:sqlite:reset: cross-env PRISMA_PROVIDER=sqlite DATABASE_URL='file:./prisma/dev.db' npx prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.prisma:supabase:migrate: cross-env PRISMA_PROVIDER=postgresql npx prisma migrate dev --name init --migrations-dir=prisma/migrations_postgres
scripts.prisma:supabase:deploy: cross-env PRISMA_PROVIDER=postgresql npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prisma:supabase:reset: cross-env PRISMA_PROVIDER=postgresql npx prisma migrate reset --force
